I built the kvhttp server in Odin. `node check.mjs` passes all 4 example cases. It uses only Odin's standard library, so `build.sh` has nothing to fetch; it builds an optimized binary at `./app`.

The code is in `src/`: `main.odin` (startup and connections), `http.odin` (request reading and responses), `router.odin` (routes and key checks) and `store.odin` (the in-memory data).
